# UserAccess - Web Accessibility Platform

> UserAccess helps websites achieve accessibility compliance with AI-powered tools and solutions.

## About

UserAccess is a web accessibility platform that provides tools and services to help websites become WCAG compliant. We offer both automated tools and customizable accessibility widgets.

## Free Tools

### Color Contrast Checker
- URL: https://useraccess.live/tools/color-contrast-checker
- Description: AI-powered WCAG 2.2 color contrast checker. Test your color combinations for accessibility compliance, extract colors from images, and get AI-powered suggestions to fix low contrast issues.

### Accessibility Statement Generator
- URL: https://useraccess.live/tools/accessibility-statement-generator
- Description: Generate professional accessibility statements for your website. Customize for your organization, select compliance standards (WCAG 2.1, WCAG 2.2, ADA, Section 508), and export in Markdown or HTML format.
